stages.description: Ordered checklist. Document order is the protocol axis. Stages with commands are machine-runnable; stages without are agent-only.

id.description: Stable id for CLI selection and command:// refs. Defaults to name when omitted.

command.description: Real argv, or only command://id refs that expand to other commands in the same stage.

run_in_file_change.description: Git path patterns; omit to always run this command.

onMissing.description: If the executable is not on PATH (spawn ENOENT), warn and continue; other failures still fail.

skip_when.description: Agent-evaluated skip hint; the CLI never evaluates it. Recommended tokens: entry_file_known, docs_only, no_behavior_change, already_verified. Free text is allowed.

tags.description: Optional semantic labels for agents (not enforced by the CLI). Recommended: needs-agent. Free text is allowed. Progressive stages map does not include tags — Read evolving.yml for the current step.

commands.description: When present, this is a machine stage. Omit for agent-only stages (edit checkpoint, docs, orient).
